start: AI Assistant open, the owner has credits; member Asha Verma has a plan that ended

steps.action: Ask "Renew Asha for 3 months, she paid 4500 cash"
user_sees: A card with rows Member (bold), Plan "name · 3 months", Dates "start → end", Price (bold), Paid now "₹4,500 cash"
A button ending "· 1 credit", "Change something", "Cancel"
"A receipt is made, the same as when you renew by hand."
must_not: Anything saved before the button is tapped
A price that differs from the plan with no "(list price …)" note
Dates that overlap the running plan without a warning

steps.action: Tap "Change something", change the amount paid, tap "Done changing"
user_sees: The rows show the new amount
must_not: The old amount is saved
The edit fields stay open over the buttons

steps.action: Tap the save button
user_sees: The button shows it is busy
A done line in green
The credits number is one lower
must_not: Two renewals or two payments
A credit taken with nothing saved
No receipt

steps.action: Open History
user_sees: The request, what it did, the India time, "Done · 1 credit"
must_not: "Not sent" for a saved task
Two credits

start: No member called Zoya; the "No member found" card is on screen

steps.action: Tap "Add Zoya as a new member", then type "Zoya 98290 11111 monthly plan, paid 1500 UPI" as a new request
user_sees: An add-member card: Name, Mobile, Plan, Dates, Price, Paid now
"A receipt is made, the same as when you add a member by hand."
must_not: A second member with a mobile number already on the list
The joining fee left out of the price

steps.action: Save
user_sees: The member, the plan and the payment are saved; 1 credit
must_not: The member saved without the plan and no word
Three credits for the three parts

start: A "who owes" card for one member is on screen

steps.action: Tap "Record a payment"
user_sees: A payment card with the member and the full amount owed
"A receipt is made, the same as when you record a payment by hand."
must_not: Paise turned into wrong rupees
The payment put against the wrong plan term

steps.action: Change the amount to part of it and save
user_sees: Saved; the member still owes the rest on Dues
must_not: The member shown as fully paid
An amount above what is owed taken without a word

steps.action: Ask "Extend Asha's plan by 5 days, she was unwell"
user_sees: A card with the member, the days and the reason
must_not: The end day moved before Save

steps.action: Ask "Save an enquiry: Ravi, wants personal training" and "Add expense 2000 electricity bill"
user_sees: An enquiry card and an expense card, each with its own save button and 1 credit
must_not: Both saved by one tap
An expense with no amount saved

start: A change card is open; the owner has 0 credits

steps.action: Tap the save button
user_sees: "You have no AI credits left. Ask MettleUp for credits to send this."
The credits sheet opens with the way to get more
The card stays open with its values
must_not: The change is saved
The balance goes below zero
The card is closed or its edits are lost

steps.action: On a renew card set the price to 0, or pick no plan
user_sees: "The price must be more than ₹0." or "Pick a plan." and the save is stopped before any credit
must_not: A credit taken for a save that was refused

steps.action: Add a member with a mobile number that is on the list
user_sees: A word that the number already exists
must_not: A second member with the same number

start: A change card is open; the owner has credits; the save will fail on the server

steps.action: Tap the save button
user_sees: The reason in calm words, then "Your credit was given back."
The card is open again
must_not: The credit kept with nothing saved and no word
A raw error text

steps.action: Tap the save button again
user_sees: A real second try
must_not: The first failure shown again without trying
"This was done already." when nothing was saved
A second credit taken

start: A change card is open and not saved

steps.action: Tap "Cancel"
user_sees: "Cancelled. Nothing was sent or saved, and no credit was used."
must_not: A credit used
The card can still be saved

steps.action: Open History
user_sees: The task with "Cancelled"; a card left alone shows "Not sent"
must_not: "Done" for a cancelled task

steps.action: Tap the row
user_sees: The request goes back in the box to ask again
must_not: The old draft is saved straight away

steps.action: On a card that was saved, press its button again or reload and repeat
user_sees: "This was done already."
must_not: A second save or a second credit

start: The owner saves a change by asking

steps.action: Ask for a change and leave the card without saving
user_sees: Nothing in the member's record
must_not: A change made by the AI without the owner's tap

steps.action: Read the notice and the credits sheet
user_sees: The request and its credits are kept 400 days; a credit is used only on Save
must_not: A front-desk login can see the owner's requests
The request kept longer than said
